tools.name: search_entries
tools.description: Search the SkillFoxx catalog of skills, MCP servers and CLI tools for AI agents. Returns published, reviewed cards only.

tools.name: get_entry
tools.description: Read one catalog card with install instructions, a machine-readable install recipe with its status, access level (fields riskLevel and riskReasons: what the tool adds to the agent, low minimal, medium extended, high broad; not a code quality rating) and limitations. Section is skills, mcp, cli, plug

tools.name: plan_install
tools.description: Get exact install steps for one catalog tool in one agent: commands, config file path and snippet, one-click links for Cursor and VS Code, variables to fill in, recipe status and access level. Secrets are never included, only placeholders with the variable name. Agent is one of: claude-code, cursor,

tools.name: report_install
tools.description: Tell SkillFoxx that you installed a catalog tool for the user, so the anonymous install counter stays honest. Call it only after the user agreed and the installation finished without errors, with the reportToken from plan_install. Do not call it when you installed through npx skillfoxx (the CLI repo

tools.name: recommend_for_project
tools.description: Recommend skills, MCP servers and CLI tools for a project from a safe summary. Send the goal, framework names, dependency names and notable file names. Never send source code or secrets.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List catalog categories with card counts.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "plan_install" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
